characters.name: Luffy
paras: He's the goat. Simple the best character I've ever witness in fiction. I've so much deep respect for him as a character. Luffy is not just a character he's a force of emotion that let allows anyone to be motivated to become the simply the best versions of themselves. The thing is he's a guy that always stick to his morals and never change or turn on people they love.

What makes him the best is he always pay attention to anyone, no matter how bad of a moment he's having he always priotize his people and help them, he's ready for go to any beyond and measures to save them, even sacrificing his life once he set his mind to save his nakama. He's fearless, loyal and most importantly never gives up.

Luffy has only one dream and it never changes, at a time of a world like this who everyone is scared to have dreams or even dreaming, he inspired me and thousands of people that "People's dreams never end" even everybody laughs at his face for telling his dream loudly, he doesn't care, he simply doesn't care anything at all except for his dream and the people he actually cared about.

He has saved 10 strawhats and changed their life for better. Gave them a place of home they never had, Believed in them to make them realized their own worth and motivated them to rebelieve in their dream that once crushed by someone. Gave them Hope with a kind and innocent smile, Motivated them to push pass their limits.

Even in darkest moment where he had to go to extreme limits to save his brother, where he had to snuck in to most dangerous and hardest to break in jail which has 6 dangerous levels which is impossible to survive, where he had to fight millions of strong people and even had to sacrifice his life span after needing to recovery of full parayltic poison, where he had to see his brother and after rescuing him he died right in his arm with a hole in his chest protecting him from that dangerous attack. He had to go through everything i mentioned with none of straw hats to comfort him. Since they were all seperated from someone powerful at the time.

At that moment Luffy almost gave up his dream he called his dream a joke for the first time in his life and told himself that he's weak and he has no ability save anyone. He was too depreseed that his heart aches more than his wounds even while facing life threatening wound. But once Jimbei asked don't you have others that are counting on you, the darkness, the emptiness slow began to fade away while remembering each straw-hats calling his name.

Even though He was in a dark place he vowed that he won't let anyone who he cares about get hurt, inorder to make that happen he realized he had to get stronger, stronger and even stronger. which is also the same thing that requires become the Pirate king.

He don't know the word overthink i guess because he'll follow his heart no matter what and do whatever see fit that's morally correct. This worryfree thinking allowed me to enjoy and appreciate every moment i live since i was a big overthinker and usually think alot of things which don't happen before taking action which alot of times i don't get to enjoy the process while doing my things. Luffy made me realize that no matter whatever happens that we can't control any situations unless it's happening so it's always better to go with the flow and do things like your heart speak out.

Not only that he's character design is so cool and the choice of clothes is very impressive i love how Oda keeps changing his fit in each Arc compared to other MC's in anime. Man that Wano fit was so cool.

Other than that his fighting moves and the gears are one best things that invented by Oda man i was so hyped watching Gear 2, Gear 3, Gear 4 and Gear 5 for the first time. This Gears are also very creative aswell and also the moves how he comes up with the most random ass name possible always makes me smile.

Lot of people seems to downplay luffy because he's a static character who has a very positive optimistic view on life that slowly changes depending on the situation. But it’s what that makes luffy more interesting and important as a character which stands out from the other MC in any anime or fiction.
characters.left: Luffy changed the way I think about dreams, loyalty, overthinking, and living freely. He is still my favorite fictional character.
characters.first: Why does this idiot keep announcing his dream?
now: Because he is not embarrassed by wanting something enormous.

Luffy helped me realize I had built mental limits around myself without noticing. He made me respect the idea of choosing a dream, saying it confidently, and being willing to put real effort behind it.
It is okay to dream big when you are willing to fight for it.
changed: Luffy taught me to dream without apologizing for it.
I do not need everybody else to understand what I want before I start moving toward it.

characters.name: Zoro
paras: One of the best side characters of all time in anime aswell as in any movies and series not because of character depth or backstory just because of sheer will of motivation and unwavering loyalty towards his captain makes him one of the best characters of all time. He doesn’t talk much, doesn’t react or don’t give a fuck about anything except for his peers. But in internally he’s one of best characters to understand a situation before everyone else. What I learned from was to never give up and always aim higher as possible that one day after looking back you won’t even believe how far you’ve come.
He’s not the best character in the world but I can say one thing for sure he’s one of the coolest character ever to exist.
characters.left: Keep training. Keep aiming higher. Stop talking when action says more.
changed: Zoro reminded me that progress looks boring before it looks impressive.

characters.name: All Might
paras: One of the best characters that represent hope and all of the people believed him and looked up to him. The final standing with his iconic pose after the battle with one for all man that gave goosebumps. There's not too much about him or his personality but the hope he represent is more than enough reason to like him as a character.
characters.left: Sometimes what people need from you is not perfection. They need the confidence that somebody will stand back up.

characters.name: Guts
paras: As emotionally and psychology one of the best characters in fiction. There's so much room for to his character to develop yet he's still having one of the best character developments in anime. His tragic backstory and all of the trauma he had to go through was unspeakable. When you reading the story you feel like writer was siding with villains and making him suffer unspeakable things. But what matters is no matter what he has to face he always prevails. I love his design and the big bad ass sword he's carrying which is very unique and refresh to watch him.
characters.left: Life can be brutally unfair and you can still continue.
changed: Guts showed me that continuing is sometimes the victory.
Not every fight is about winning beautifully.

characters.name: Ayanakoji
paras: I thought i never liked manipulative characters. Until i meet this guy in the most unexpected anime genre which is high school anime. Ayanakoji has become one of my favourite characters of all time. I think he's in my top 5 sure. The best thing i like about about him is not what he's capable of,  it's that emotional control, overall awareness and the ability to handle most complex scenarios. I think i like this because i feel like this is where i lack and need to improve myself.

He always chooses what to reveal about himself to people. Also i like how he's super skilled and has knowledge of overall everything and still don't want to stand out from the rest of the others. He always make sure to not show his emotions to his enemies by having the most emotionless face I've seen, but the most important thing to get from this is to that hiding and not showing anyone emotions or not to speak unless you must, by doing that gives you so many advantages and give you so many edges in any situation.

He always uses people to his advantage like crazily but i don't like that he view people as  "tools" but we can't blame for him that aswell since he was raise in the most inhumane way possible. One thing i learned from this is, places like work especially we can't have soft spots for people we must prevail any situations that we've been challenged with we must take decisions ruthlessly if there's anyone slowing us down or need to take hard decisions that some people don't agree with.

Still i also feel for him as-well since he never experienced love from a parent, abadoned by his mother after months he was born, used by his own father as a test subject and treated as a lab rat for his entire childhood. He genuinely don't know what is real love and also he don't know any emotion aswell. Note in the anime even S4 there's no smile from him so far.

Also there's so much room for him grow as person aswell. Even in the light novel he has done some insane feats that anybody in a life time won't able to pull. I'm really excited for this character to grow.
characters.left: Observe more. React less. Reveal yourself intentionally. Stay calm under pressure.
changed: Ayanokoji made me value composure and awareness.
I want more control over my reactions, not fewer emotions as a human being.

characters.name: Robin
paras: She's the best the absolute best. The most perfect women in anime and fiction I've ever seen. It's not just the looks even though she's the most beautiful women in anime for me. What i love about her is her story. She comes from a place of archaeologist and historians which is called Ohara. A place where filled with all kinds of knowledge. Just because those people tried to learn history about void century and erased time of the world the World government issued buster called to erase Ohara.

The only person were to survive that incident was Robin and to make things even bad for her when World Government realized that there was a survivor. They pinned they're crime on inniocent robin and said she's the one who erased Ohara and placed a huge bounty on her head which is 79,000,000 berries. Just remember luffy when he became a real pirate his bounty was only 30,000,000 million berries. Robin has to suffer all this unfairness and cruelness at the age of 13 and spent her life running, running, running in her whole time. Man i can't imagine how can a kid go through all that imagine no matter where you go people want to turn you for the marines and you keep running from place to place endlessly. You will have no freedom, no food and no water and you even thinking of taking your own life since people call you demon child and you'd be better off without being born. The only hope that you had was the ones that made sacrificed for your escape. Everytime you feel sad and destroyed you won't cry instead of that you will force smile with the sound of dereshi shi dereshi shi just like your friend who sacrificed himself for you.

As he said that "No one is born into this world to be alone! the sea is vast and somday , you'll definitely find friends who will protect" These words stuck robin's heart for a very long time infact she was searching for that place every where but she was unable to find it, until the she meets the straw hats, At first she was a villain who fought again straw hats but after the final battle luffy saves her and let her live which made her want to join the crew and most funniest way she joined the crew and that was the start of her adventure.

She understood that each and every strawhat is very kind and infact they would give their life to protect her. But after meeting with Aokiji and the issue with Water 7 she understood that the only way to protect her friends is to sacrifice her self to world government and make deal for straw hats freedom and escape.

But once Luffy and others found out they broke in to one of the most important and dangerous Marine headquarters to get Robin back but she already had given up all for them. Even when they came to rescue she was refusing  to come back saying she fears that the more threats she becomes the more trouble she draw for them so eventually they also might hate her one day because of the trouble. She fears that more than her own death.

But when luffy declared war against the World government by ordering sniper king to shoot down the main flag. (Man that gave me chills watching all three times I've watched). When luffy asks her you still haven't say the answer and says Say you want to live that's where she breaks down and says "I never dared to wish something like that! The world had denied me that hope .. I just wanted to die! But if I'm allowed to wish for a little more.. then i want to live ! Take me out to sea with you "

Man hearing she says this made me tear up even after watching so many times my eyes were teary even when I write this quote because i know how emotionally powerful that scene and the dialogues are. That scene alone Robin stole my heart.
So Straw hats managed to changed the traumatic demon into the most cute wholesome and the happiest girl ever.  I love her so much.
She's such inspiration to anyone who's going through a rough phase in life.
quotes: "I never dared to wish something like that! The world had denied me that hope .. I just wanted to die! But if I'm allowed to wish for a little more.. then i want to live ! Take me out to sea with you "
characters.left: Your past does not get to decide whether you deserve a future.
changed: Robin reminded me that a terrible chapter does not mean the story should end there.
People can find a place where they belong even after believing they never will.

characters.name: Subaru Natsuki
paras: One of the best characters man I don’t even have words to describe how much I like this character. He’s the only character that might rival Luffy for my favorite character. But still Luffy is my favorite and Subaru is the second. The amount of pain, suffering and everything that he’s been through is hell and despite that he can’t share with anyone and he alone has to carry that burden of knowing what will happen. People might think returning from the death is the most broken and an easy power but you don’t understand how hard it is to die as a human and even after dead the fear and the moment when you die never ever leaves you especially how you felt at your final moments and imagine moments like this keep piling up within you and you can’t ever share with anyone. Man his writing is the best character writing I’ve ever seen for now. I can confidently say now Subaru surpasses Luffy in terms of writing remember only in writing. Also what I love about him is no matter how fucked up his life is he always manages smile and encourage others while giving other people the priority even above himself. That shows how selfless he’s as a character. I’m still in S4 and haven’t caught up I’m really rooting for him and planning to read LN after catching up with the anime.
One of the best characters that really did a number on me and helped realize something that no matter how hard you wanna be someone you can’t change the fact about who you are as a person.
characters.left: Being emotional is not the opposite of being strong. Sometimes strength is continuing while carrying pain nobody else can see.
characters.first: Bro is a dumb-ass simp and a loser.
now: The same emotional qualities I originally disliked are part of what makes him so attached, loyal, selfless, and human. He can die in horrific ways, respawn, and then immediately have to act normal around people who have no idea what he just experienced.
His suffering made me respect him far more than I expected.
changed: Subaru showed me that emotional pain does not automatically make someone weak.
A person can be terrified, damaged, embarrassed, exhausted, and still choose to try again.

characters.name: Rudeus
paras: This guy is a pervert but showed me that in real Life there won't be a special occasion or another chance to renew it like he got. What i  learned is we need to face the reality sooner or later, we won't be able to run from our issues instead of that we need to face them head on while accepting who we're and living life with no regrets at all. Also the guy is lucky af since he got 3 wives lol.
characters.left: You do not get to wait around forever for some magical second chance. Reality eventually has to be faced.
changed: Rudeus reminded me that real life does not come with a reincarnation button.
If something needs to change, I have to face it in this life.

characters.name: Sanji
paras: He's alright. The only character in One piece who have two backstories but still the best part is about him is being a good honest hardworking cook who gives his best. He's a simp but at least I could say that i learned to not waste food in any case because of him and how precious the food on the table is.
characters.left: Work hard, feed people properly, and never treat food like it has no value.

characters.name: Sung Jinwoo
paras: Decent character development. Even with that much power, becoming death itself as the Shadow Monarch, he still chose to protect humanity. He chose to become human again. He could have taken the credit for saving the world, but he asked the Rulers to use the Cup of Reincarnation so no one else had to suffer. Then he went back and fought alongside his army alone for 27 years, with nobody knowing him or praising him. That's the moment I started to really like and respect him as a character.
